# MossA local Basin patch

Basin 3.2.0 is vendored so these optimizations are reproducible without modifying the Cargo registry or other projects. Original MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses and the frozen direct-SVD reference are retained.

- `svd-norm-cache.patch`: exact column-norm caching. Reuse a norm only while its column is unchanged, invalidating both entries after a Jacobi rotation. The original ordered hypot fold, rotations and thresholds are retained.
- `solver-linear-algebra.patch`: expose the existing row-major matrix refill operation, permit convergence builders with typed evaluation workspaces, reuse gradient storage, and add opt-in Householder-QR compression before the Jacobi SVD.

QR compression is off by default in Basin. MossA enables it for analytical models except mixed ordinary/distribution site models. Explicit numerical fits and bounded-LM recovery retain the direct solver. Small matrices (fewer than three columns, or fewer than four times as many rows as columns), numerical failures, and matrices whose smallest singular value is at most sqrt(machine epsilon) times the largest retain the original direct SVD.

The QR path scales inputs, uses Householder reflections and factors the small triangular matrix. The subsequent `implicit-q-fused.patch` retains the Householder reflectors and the small left singular factor instead of rebuilding tall left singular vectors. It applies Q transpose to the augmented residual once per model and reuses its projection across rejected trials. It never forms normal equations. Jacobi convergence tolerance and trust-step rank cutoff retain the original tall row count. Trust-region criteria, bounds, damping/radius rules and iteration budgets are unchanged. MossA's final full-Jacobian covariance uses its existing nalgebra path and is unaffected by this optimization.

The local patch applies after the norm-cache patch, against the frozen pre-buffer/QR files. Stage source/binary hashes, fit validation and benchmarks are documented in `validation-data/performance/SOLVER-LINEAR-ALGEBRA.md` in the MossA repository. Microtests cover reconstruction, spectra and trust steps across extreme scales, plus exact direct-factorization fallback and unchanged cached/reference SVD factors/steps.

`implicit-q-fused.patch` applies after `solver-linear-algebra.patch`. It preserves original row-based tolerances, direct-SVD paths and rank-loss safeguards. Reconstruction is now test-only. MossA also fuses the thin variable-projection nonlinear Jacobian and residual-dependent correction while retaining the original area-dependent arithmetic and fallback kernels; final full-Jacobian covariance is unchanged. See `validation-data/performance/IMPLICIT-Q-FUSED.md`.

`stable-norm.patch` applies after `implicit-q-fused.patch`. QR-compressed analytical factors with at least eight columns use two-pass scaled sum-of-squares norms for Householder columns and Jacobi column normalization. Smaller reduced models retain ordered hypot, preserving near-roundoff velocity-calibration convergence. Direct SVD, rank-loss fallbacks, rotation formulas, row-based tolerances and full covariance retain their original paths. The analytical evaluator also precomputes immutable spectrum weights, exact background powers and parameter layouts, with dynamic simplex derivatives preserved. See `validation-data/performance/NORM-PRECOMPUTE.md`.
